description: This file defines the EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver class, which implements the IEventHubReceiver interface. It is responsible for receiving EventData from an Event Hub partition, using a data generator, and includes methods for receiving data asynchronously, stopping data production, configuring data generation, and closing the receiver.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver
classes.description: A receiver class for Event Hubs that uses a data generator to produce EventData, capable of receiving, stopping, configuring, and closing the data stream.

methods.name: EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with a data generator.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously receives EventData, simulating response delay, and returns generated events or waits if none are available.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production on a specified stream.

methods.name: ConfigureDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Configures the data generator for a specific stream.
